objects.name: strict_project_context_update
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER strict_project_context_update AFTER UPDATE OF area_id,goal_id ON projects
   WHEN OLD.area_id IS NOT NEW.area_id OR OLD.goal_id IS NOT NEW.goal_id
   BEGIN
    INSERT INTO task_context_history(task_id,previous_project_id,area_id,goal_id,reason,created_at)
     SELECT id,project_id,area_id,goal_id,'project_context_changed',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tasks
     WHERE project_id=NEW.id AND (area_id IS NOT NEW.area_id OR goal_id IS NOT NEW.goal_id);
    UPDATE tasks SET area_id=NEW.area_id,goal_id=NEW.goal_id WHERE project_id=NEW.id;
   END

objects.name: strict_task_context_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER strict_task_context_insert AFTER INSERT ON tasks
    WHEN NEW.project_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE id=NEW.project_id)
     AND (NEW.area_id IS NOT (SELECT CASE WHEN area_id IN (SELECT id FROM areas) THEN area_id ELSE NULL END FROM projects WHERE id=NEW.project_id) OR NEW.goal_id IS NOT (SELECT CASE WHEN goal_id IN (SELECT id FROM goals) THEN goal_id ELSE NULL END FROM projects WHERE id=NEW.project_id))
    BEGIN
     INSERT INTO task_context_history(task_id,previous_project_id,area_id,goal_id,reason,created_at)
     VALUES(NEW.id,NEW.project_id,NEW.area_id,NEW.goal_id,'task_project_context',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
     UPDATE tasks SET area_id=(SELECT CASE WHEN area_id IN (SELECT id FROM areas) THEN area_id ELSE NULL END FROM projects WHERE id=NEW.project_id),goal_id=(SELECT CASE WHEN goal_id IN (SELECT id FROM goals) THEN goal_id ELSE NULL END FROM projects WHERE id=NEW.project_id) WHERE id=NEW.id;
    END

objects.name: strict_task_context_update
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER strict_task_context_update AFTER UPDATE OF project_id, area_id, goal_id ON tasks
    WHEN NEW.project_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE id=NEW.project_id)
     AND (NEW.area_id IS NOT (SELECT CASE WHEN area_id IN (SELECT id FROM areas) THEN area_id ELSE NULL END FROM projects WHERE id=NEW.project_id) OR NEW.goal_id IS NOT (SELECT CASE WHEN goal_id IN (SELECT id FROM goals) THEN goal_id ELSE NULL END FROM projects WHERE id=NEW.project_id))
    BEGIN
     INSERT INTO task_context_history(task_id,previous_project_id,area_id,goal_id,reason,created_at)
     VALUES(NEW.id,OLD.project_id,OLD.area_id,OLD.goal_id,'task_project_context',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
     UPDATE tasks SET area_id=(SELECT CASE WHEN area_id IN (SELECT id FROM areas) THEN area_id ELSE NULL END FROM projects WHERE id=NEW.project_id),goal_id=(SELECT CASE WHEN goal_id IN (SELECT id FROM goals) THEN goal_id ELSE NULL END FROM projects WHERE id=NEW.project_id) WHERE id=NEW.id;
    END
